maddeler.e:
تذابحت (form VI)
# تَذَابَحْتُ (taḏābaḥtu) /ta.ðaː.baħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَذَابَحَ (taḏābaḥa)
# تَذَابَحْتَ (taḏābaḥta) /ta.ðaː.baħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَذَابَحَ (taḏābaḥa)
# تَذَابَحْتِ (taḏābaḥti) /ta.ðaː.baħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَذَابَحَ (taḏābaḥa)
# تَذَابَحَتْ (taḏābaḥat) /ta.ðaː.ba.ħat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
